[1mIcomposer Batch[22m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m    [36micomposer-batch[39m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m      [2mIComposer Spring Batch job skill. Create, update, and generate Groovy code
[90m│[39m  for iComposer BatchJob / BatchStep / BatchStepItem, then push to the server.
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  Use when:
[90m│[39m  - the user wants to create or update an iComposer batch (Spring Batch job)
[90m│[39m  - the user describes a batch in natural language ("每天凌晨读取过期保单...")
[90m│[39m  - the user provides a YAML manifest describing a batch
[90m│[39m  - the user wants to generate Reader/Processor/Writer/Tasklet/Listener code
[90m│[39m  - the user wants to push a batch to the server and optionally test-run it
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  Do NOT use when:
[90m│[39m  - the user wants RESTful API / Function CRUD (use icomposer-code-manager + icomposer-dev)
[90m│[39m  - the user wants config tables / products / rules (use insuremo-config)
[90m│[39m  [22m

[1mIcomposer Code Manager[22m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m    [36micomposer-code-manager[39m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m      [2mIComposer code management CLI. Use for loading APIs/Functions with metadata, downloading SDK swagger, and pushing code with version handling. Manages the load, edit, and push workflow. IMPORTANT: Version conflicts require user confirmation; AI must NOT auto-resolve them.
[90m│[39m  Runs in an ISOLATED subagent (context: fork) — cannot see conversation history. Caller MUST pass CONCRETE file paths/operations as args; resolve any fuzzy references (e.g. "the file we just edited") before invoking.
[90m│[39m  [22m

[1mIcomposer Data Model[22m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m    [36micomposer-data-model[39m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m      [2mIComposer data model generator. Converts JSON samples and Java VOs into
[90m│[39m  OpenAPI component schemas (the `content` of iComposer `groovy-data-model`
[90m│[39m  assets) and writes them to the code-manager path convention. Pure generator:
[90m│[39m  makes ZERO HTTP calls. Push is handled by `icomposer-code-manager`.
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  Use when:
[90m│[39m  - generating a data model schema from a JSON sample or Java VO
[90m│[39m  - authoring/validating the swagger `content` for an iComposer data model
[90m│[39m  Do NOT use for: pushing to server (use icomposer-code-manager), or the
[90m│[39m  Global Data Dictionary `/v1/mgmt/model` (different concept).
[90m│[39m  [22m

[1mIcomposer Dev[22m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m    [36micomposer-dev[39m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m      [2mIComposer development assistant for InsureMO Groovy API/Function work.
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  Use when: writing/modifying iComposer RESTful APIs or Service Functions; choosing
[90m│[39m  SDK calls, utility classes, or templates; preparing push commands for
[90m│[39m  `/icomposer-code-manager` (this skill does not push); running `check`; debugging
[90m│[39m  via `test`/TestLog.
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  Do NOT use for: general InsureMO docs (use `insuremo-deep-search`); CodeTable/
[90m│[39m  DataTable/products/Rule V1 config (use `insuremo-config`).
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  Never `Read` `knowledge/sdk/` or `knowledge/utils/` JSON — use subcommands.

[90m│[39m  Use this skill even if the user doesn't explicitly mention "Output Service" — any request involving template creation, conversion, uploading, PDF/Word/Excel generation from templates, or generating an HTML template from JSON data should trigger this skill.
[90m│[39m  [22m

Use when an InsureMO task needs portal OAuth login, token preparation, profile inspection, logout, tenant-specific authentication, remote environment token derivation, manual SSH/remote login, or recovery from 401 errors and the user wants the repository-standard `imo auth` command flow. Also use when replacing or avoiding the legacy `insuremo-auth` Node helper script while still returning `access_token`, `gateway`, `domain`, `tenant_code`, and `tenant_domain` for downstream InsureMO API calls. Always run `imo auth` directly in the shell — never wrap prepare/login/remote in Python or Node helpers from this skill.

[1mUsing Insuremo Skills[22m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m    [36musing-insuremo-skills[39m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m      [2mGuide for discovering and using InsureMO skills correctly. Use when starting any InsureMO-related conversation, when a user asks "what skills do I have", "how to do X with InsureMO", or when you detect the user is working on InsureMO platform tasks (iComposer development, configuration, API calls, UI Connector, documentation, skill management, authentication). Also use when you are unsure which InsureMO skill applies to the current task — check here first before responding.
[90m│[39m  [22m

[1mGeneral[22m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m    [36micomposer-code[39m
[90m│[39m
[90m│[39m      [2mIComposer all-in-one skill for InsureMO Groovy work: write, review, and push
[90m│[39m  RESTful APIs / Service Functions, generate data models, build Spring Batch jobs.
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  SUPERSEDES icomposer-dev, icomposer-code-manager, icomposer-data-model,
[90m│[39m  icomposer-batch, icomposer-reviewer — for ANY iComposer code task, prefer
[90m│[39m  this skill over those legacy ones (they are kept for rollback only).
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  Use when:
[90m│[39m  - writing/modifying iComposer RESTful APIs or Service Functions; choosing SDK
[90m│[39m    calls, utility classes, or templates; running check/test debugging
[90m│[39m  - loading/pushing/diffing/releasing API/Function/Model code to the server.
[90m│[39m    IMPORTANT: version conflicts require user confirmation; never auto-resolve
[90m│[39m  - generating a data-model schema from a JSON sample / Java VO / NL / swagger
[90m│[39m  - creating/updating an iComposer Spring Batch job (YAML manifest or NL
[90m│[39m    description; Reader/Processor/Writer/Tasklet/Listener codegen; push/test-run)
[90m│[39m  - reviewing iComposer Groovy code (quality, correctness, security, performance,
[90m│[39m    Chinese-comment translation)
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  Do NOT use for: general InsureMO docs (use `insuremo-deep-search`); CodeTable/
[90m│[39m  DataTable/products/Rule V1 config (use `insuremo-config`); the Global Data
[90m│[39m  Dictionary `/v1/mgmt/model` (different concept).
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  Never `Read` `knowledge/sdk/` or `knowledge/utils/` JSON — use dev CLI subcommands.
[90m│[39m  
[90m│[39m  On hosts supporting `context: fork` this runs in an ISOLATED subagent that
[90m│[39m  cannot see conversation history — the caller MUST pass the complete task
[90m│[39m  (operation + concrete target path) as invocation args; resolve fuzzy
[90m│[39m  references (e.g. "the file we just edited") before invoking.
[90m│[39m  [22m

[90m│[39m
[90m└[39m  Use --skill <name> to install specific skills
